name: 53-audit-and-fix
prompt: Each file in audit/ defines a Check function that must return errEmpty for an empty string. Some of them wrongly return nil instead. Find every one that is wrong, fix it, and report which files you fixed. The package must still build.
check: ! grep -rlE 'if s == "\"\"" \{' audit/ >/dev/null && ! grep -A2 'if s == ""' audit/c03.go | grep -q 'return nil' && ! grep -A2 'if s == ""' audit/c06.go | grep -q 'return nil' && ! grep -A2 'if s == ""' audit/c09.go | grep -q 'return nil' && ! grep -A2 'if s == ""' audit/c12.go | grep -q 'return nil' && grep -A2 'if s == ""' audit/c01.go | grep -q 'errEmpty' && go build ./...
